description: Verification without escrow (arl-attestation/1): decide a verdict from validator signatures. The platform keeps its own payments; it sends the signed verdicts it collected for one request, and this checks each signature, that it is about this request, spec and deliverable, and that the signer has at least minStake free stake on the ARL verified evaluator now. Returns approved, rejected or undecided.

minStake.description: Smallest free stake in base units (default 100 ARL)

name: arl_check_verdict
